mapper.sql: id, facility_name, facility_type, address, contract_power_kw, manager_name, manager_phone, is_active, operation_start_date, operation_end_date, created_at, ST_Y(facility_center::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(facility_center::geometry) AS longitude
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM company_facilities WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN facility_type = 'HQ' OR facility_name LIKE '%본사%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_facilities ( company_id, facility_name, facility_type, address, contract_power_kw, manager_name, manager_phone, is_active, operation_start_date, operation_end_date, facility_center, created_at ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{dto.facilityName}, #{dto.facilityType}, #{dto.address}, #{dto.contractPowerKw}, #{dto.managerName}, #{dto.managerPhone}, COALESCE(#{dto.active}, TRUE), #{dto.operationStartDate}, #{dto.operationEndDate}, CASE WHEN #{dto.longitude} IS NOT NULL AND #{dto.latitude} IS NOT NULL THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{dto.longitude}, #{dto.latitude}), 4326) ELSE NULL END, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE company_facilities SET facility_name = #{dto.facilityName}, facility_type = #{dto.facilityType}, address = #{dto.address}, contract_power_kw = #{dto.contractPowerKw}, manager_name = #{dto.managerName}, manager_phone = #{dto.managerPhone}, is_active = COALESCE(#{dto.active}, is_active), operation_start_date = #{dto.operationStartDate}, operation_end_date = #{dto.operationEndDate}, facility_center = CASE WHEN #{dto.longitude} IS NOT NULL AND #{dto.latitude} IS NOT NULL THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{dto.longitude}, #{dto.latitude}), 4326) ELSE facility_center END WHERE id = #{dto.id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
